title: หนุ่มเมียนมา ซิ่งรถฟอร์จูนเนอร์ ชน จยย.ดับ 1 พลเมืองดีควบคุมตัว บอกดื่มมาหนึ่งกระป๋อง

title_cn: 缅甸青年高速驾驶幸运车致1死1伤
summary_cn: 22日上午在农南他武里（Nonthaburi）发生严重交通事故。一名缅甸青年驾驶幸运车（Fortuner）高速行驶，与摩托车发生碰撞，摩托车飞越对向车道，驾驶员当场死亡，另有1人受伤。肇事车辆撞向路标杆，肇事者已被警方控制，自称事故前饮用过一罐啤酒。

title: New skywalk eases access to historic Talat Phlu community
desc: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has opened a new skywalk across Khlong Bangkok Yai, linking Bangkok Yai and Thon Buri districts and improving access to the historic Talat Phlu community.
title_cn: 曼谷新建人行天桥 便利塔拉普鲁历史社区出行
summary_cn: 曼谷大都会管理局（BMA）新开放了一条横跨郭邦艾运河（Khlong Bangkok Yai）的天桥，连接曼谷艾区（Bangkok Yai）和通武里区（Thon Buri）。这项基础设施改善工程大幅便利了进入历史悠久的塔拉普鲁社区（Talat Phlu）的出行，为当地居民和游客提供了更安全便利的通道。
desc_original: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has opened a new skywalk across Khlong Bangkok Yai, linking Bangkok Yai and Thon Buri districts and improving access to the historic Talat Phlu community.

title: Thai youth showcase conservation efforts at COP31 climate summit
desc: Thai youth representatives took centre stage at the UN's COP31 climate summit, sharing their experiences in forest and wildlife conservation and highlighting young people's role in environmental protection.
title_cn: 泰国青年在COP31气候峰会展示生态保护成果
summary_cn: 泰国青年代表在联合国COP31气候峰会上发声，分享森林与野生动物保护的实践经验与成果。泰国青年通过展示本地生态保护项目，强调年轻一代在应对气候变化和环保中的重要角色，彰显泰国在全球气候行动中的承诺。
desc_original: Thai youth representatives took centre stage at the UN's COP31 climate summit, sharing their experiences in forest and wildlife conservation and highlighting young people's role in environmental protection.

title: PM rejects Cambodia  conciliation
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has reaffirmed Thailand's opposition to Cambodia's compulsory conciliation bid over their maritime dispute, warning that other bilateral talks cannot proceed while Phnom Penh insists on that approach.
title_cn: 总理拒绝柬埔寨调解提案
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷·查尼瓦拉重申，泰国坚决反对柬埔寨对泰柬海事争端提出的强制调解方案。他明确警告，只要金边（Phnom Penh）继续坚持强制调解立场，双方的其他重要双边会谈将无法取得进展。此举充分反映了泰国在维护领土主权和海事权益上的原则立场。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has reaffirmed Thailand's opposition to Cambodia's compulsory conciliation bid over their maritime dispute, warning that other bilateral talks cannot proceed while Phnom Penh insists on that approach.

title: NACC member in soup over 'bribe'
desc: An independent panel has unanimously found grounds to pursue corruption allegations against National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) member Ekkawit Watchawalku over an alleged 246-baht gold bribe from former deputy national police chief Pol Gen Surachate Hakparn, news media say.
title_cn: 国家反腐委员会成员因受贿陷入困境
summary_cn: 独立调查小组一致裁定，对国家反腐委员会成员艾卡威特指控其从前副警察局长苏拉差特收取246泰铢黄金贿赂有充分理由追究。这一腐败丑闻涉及政府高层廉政问题，直接威胁国家反腐机构本身的公信力和独立性。此案件引起各方关注，可能对泰国反腐工作和政治环境产生重要影响。
desc_original: An independent panel has unanimously found grounds to pursue corruption allegations against National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) member Ekkawit Watchawalku over an alleged 246-baht gold bribe from former deputy national police chief Pol Gen Surachate Hakparn, news media say.

title: Faith finds a greener path
desc: Thailand's so-called "faith economy" has become an economic driver as people increasingly turn to spiritual items in search of luck and prosperity. But the growing popularity of religious offerings has created a waste problem for temples and shrines, prompting calls for a greener approach to faith.
title_cn: 信仰找到「绿色」之路
summary_cn: 泰国的「信仰经济」已成为重要的经济增长驱动力，民众为求好运和繁荣纷纷购买宗教用品。然而宗教祭品激增给寺庙和神社带来严重的废弃物问题，引发人们对更加环保方式的呼吁。许多信仰场所正在探索可持续发展的供奉模式，以平衡精神信仰与生态保护。
desc_original: Thailand's so-called "faith economy" has become an economic driver as people increasingly turn to spiritual items in search of luck and prosperity. But the growing popularity of religious offerings has created a waste problem for temples and shrines, prompting calls for a greener approach to faith.

title: Anutin defends US trade agreement as best possible outcome
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul defended Thailand's trade deal with the US, insisting the kingdom had secured the greatest possible benefits despite its limited bargaining power.
title_cn: 阿努廷为泰美贸易协议辩护称系最佳方案
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷为日前签署的泰美贸易协议进行辩护，表示鉴于泰国在国际贸易谈判中的相对地位限制，该协议已成功争取到了最大可能利益。协议涉及关税减让、农产品贸易、制造业合作等关键领域，对泰国经济发展具有长远意义。此协议是泰国经济外交战略的重要成果。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul defended Thailand's trade deal with the US, insisting the kingdom had secured the greatest possible benefits despite its limited bargaining power.

title: Ties with Myanmar stay despite ICJ ruling: PM
desc: Thailand will maintain relations with Myanmar despite an International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Saturday.
title_cn: 国际法院裁决后泰国与缅甸关系不变
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷宣布，尽管国际法院（ICJ）近日裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人（Rohingya）犯有种族灭绝罪，泰国将继续维持与缅甸的外交关系和双边合作。这一表态充分显示泰国在地区外交中采取的实用主义立场，优先考虑与邻国的经贸利益和战略协调。泰国与东南亚邻国的关系仍以实际合作为核心。
desc_original: Thailand will maintain relations with Myanmar despite an International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Saturday.

title: Anutin sees no escalation in Gen Z rallies
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said he is monitoring demonstrations by the Gen Z protest movement but has not seen indications the rallies are escalating.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷：Gen Z集会未见升级迹象
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·尊瓦拉库尔表示，他正在监控Gen Z抗议运动的示威活动，但目前未见任何表明集会规模升级的迹象。这反映了政府对年轻一代政治诉求的观察监控态度。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said he is monitoring demonstrations by the Gen Z protest movement but has not seen indications the rallies are escalating.

title: 973 pavilions set for royal cremation
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Saturday handed over 1,071 ceremonial fire-lighting kits for public sandalwood flower-laying ceremonies marking the royal cremation of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother.
title_cn: 973座亭阁为皇家火葬仪式做准备
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·尊瓦拉库尔向公众发放1071套祭奠仪式点火工具，为已故皇后母亲思里基特皇后（Queen Sirikit）的火葬典礼做准备。各地将举行白檀木花瓣祭奠仪式，向这位重要皇室成员表示尊敬。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Saturday handed over 1,071 ceremonial fire-lighting kits for public sandalwood flower-laying ceremonies marking the royal cremation of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother.

title: Govt moves to curb river toxins
desc: The government is preparing to declare pollution control zones covering more than 150 kilometres along the Mekong River and surrounding areas as it steps up efforts to tackle contamination affecting water sources in the upper North.
title_cn: 政府采取行动治理河流污染
summary_cn: 泰国政府正筹备宣布沿湄公河（Mekong）及周边地区超过150公里的污染控制区，进一步加强污染控制工作，以解决影响泰国北部水源的污染问题。此举旨在保护当地饮用水安全和环境卫生。
desc_original: The government is preparing to declare pollution control zones covering more than 150 kilometres along the Mekong River and surrounding areas as it steps up efforts to tackle contamination affecting water sources in the upper North.

title: Chanthaburi elephant calf losing fear of people, keepers cut contact
desc: Chanthaburi elephant calf losing fear of people, keepers cut contact Legacy An orphaned wild elephant calf at the Khao Soi Dao Wildlife Breeding Station in Chanthaburi has begun following its keepers and lost its fear of people, so staff have cut back on direct contact to keep it from becoming tame. Vets reported yesterday, November 21, that the male calf, aged about one to two years, is healthy and recovering steadily. The Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) moved the calf to the station late on November 1, after rangers found it standing beside its dead mother in a rubber plantation in Phawa subdistrict, Kaeng Hang Maeo district, with a loose snare on its front left leg. A post-mortem was ordered on the mother, and no cause of death has been made public. Keepers have changed the way they feed the calf and now strictly limit touching it, the station’s veterinary team said, because they want to keep its wild instincts as intact as possible. The calf now eats 13.4 kilogrammes of natural plants a day, including banana stems and leaves, ripe bananas, bamboo leaves and wild grasses. desc: The operator of the MRT Blue and Purple lines in Bangkok is preparing to replace traditional single-journey tokens with QR code tickets, with passengers expected to be able to test the new system from December.

summary_cn: 曼谷地铁蓝线和紫线运营商计划从2027年1月1日起，用QR code二维码车票取代传统单程代币。乘客可从12月起开始测试这一新系统。此项升级将提升出行便利度，推进曼谷公共交通现代化建设。

title: Thailand land appraisal values to rise 16% from January, lifting property costs
desc: Thailand land appraisal values to rise 16% from January, lifting property costs Legacy Official land appraisal values across Thailand will rise by more than 16% on average from January 1, 2027, and the highest, on central Bangkok roads such as Silom and Ploenchit , will pass 1 million baht per square wah. Buyers, owners and developers will pay higher transfer fees and land tax on the new values. Treasury Department Director-General Teeraluck Saengsanit told Prachachat Turakij that the department has revalued 37 million plots for the 2027 to 2030 cycle, replacing values from 2023 to 2026 that were compiled seven to eight years ago. The largest increases fall on Bangkok business roads such as Rama I and Wireless Road, though official values there still sit below selling prices. Photo courtesy of Prachachat The Agency for Real Estate Affairs (AREA), a private valuation firm, puts market prices for Siam, Chidlom and Ploenchit at 3.95 million baht per square wah this year, up 2.6%, with Wireless Road at 3.15 million baht, according to its president Sopon Pornchokchai. He forecast that land prices would rise by an average of 3.5% a year from 2027 to 2032. Isara Boonyoung, honorary presid

summary_cn: 泰国财政部宣布2027至2030年度官方地价评估将平均上升16%以上。曼谷是隆路 Silom 和披隆集路 Ploenchit 等主要商业区的地价将突破100万铢每平方瓦的历史高位。购房者、业主和开发商需支付更高的转让费及土地税。

title: Thailand foreign tourist arrivals reach 26.76 million, down 4.66%
desc: Thailand foreign tourist arrivals reach 26.76 million, down 4.66% Legacy Thailand foreign tourist arrivals reached 26.76 million between January 1 and November 14, which is 4.66% fewer than in the same period last year, and the government has stepped up its high-season promotions. The Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) expects about 6 million foreign visitors in November and December, roughly 3 million a month. Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said foreign visitors spent 1,304,947 million baht over the period. China was the largest market with 4,385,062 arrivals, followed by Malaysia with 3,384,864, India with 2,013,658, Russia with 1,515,102 and South Korea with 977,164. In the week of November 8 to 14, the ministry said, arrivals rose 4.26% on the previous week to an average of 94,789 a day. Short-haul markets grew 2.15%, helped by a 42.40% jump in visitors from India, while long-haul markets grew 7.04%. Some European markets are also recovering. The fall in French arrivals narrowed from 6.32% in October to 2.16% last week, and German arrivals, which were down 6.61% in October, grew 0.52%. title_cn: 泰国外国游客人数同比下滑4.66%，全年累计超2600万人次

title: Chiang Rai river pollution zone planned as hotel bookings fall below half
desc: Chiang Rai river pollution zone planned as hotel bookings fall below half Legacy Thailand plans to declare a pollution control zone covering more than 100 kilometres of the Kok, Sai and Ruak rivers over contamination blamed on mining in Myanmar, and a tourism group says Chiang Rai hotel bookings have fallen below 50%. Thai and Myanmar officials meet in Bangkok on November 25 and 26. Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin said Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul had ordered the zone, which would last about six months and could reach 500 metres to 1 kilometre inland. Measures could include bans on activities that release toxins, round-the-clock monitoring and controls on moving chemicals. The Pollution Control Department is due to submit the proposal on November 27, and the National Environment Board, chaired by Deputy Prime Minister Songsak Thongsri, will receive the plan on December 2. summary_cn: 泰国计划在清莱地区超100公里的Kok河、Sai河和Ruak河沿岸划定污染控制区，以应对源自缅甸采矿业的河流污染。该措施预计维持约6个月，涵盖沿河500米至1公里的陆地区域，包括禁止有毒物质排放等严格管制。受污染影响，清莱酒店预订率已跌至50%以下。

title: Malaysian arrested over alleged Bangkok phone scam that cost woman 8 million baht
desc: Malaysian arrested over alleged Bangkok phone scam that cost woman 8 million baht Legacy A 36 year old Malaysian man has been arrested in Bangkok, accused of collecting cash for a phone scam gang whose members posed as officials and took about 8.25 million baht in cash and gold from a 75 year old woman in Bang Bon district. Police say the same man also collected 1.95 million baht from an 18 year old university student in Samut Prakan. Police announced the arrest of Muhammad Nor bin Abu Bakar at Bang Bon Police Station yesterday, November 20, and said officers detained him at a hotel in Lat Phrao district on a Thonburi Criminal Court warrant for jointly committing fraud by impersonating another person. The woman, whom police identified only by a pseudonym, told investigators that a caller contacted her on October 12 and asked whether she had ordered banned drugs, then told her to report to police in Mae Sot, Tak province. She withdrew 950,000 baht on October 14, 2 million baht on October 21 and 3 million baht on October 22, and on November 7 gave the gang a further 1 million baht along with gold weighing 20 baht, the Thai unit for gold, handing over each at her home. title: Daily Bangkok to London flights among 87 airlines’ Thai slot requests
desc: Daily Bangkok to London flights among 87 airlines’ Thai slot requests Legacy Eighty-seven passenger and cargo airlines have applied for Thai airport slots or schedule changes for summer 2027, according to the Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand (CAAT). The requests include a plan by Norse Atlantic UK to raise its Bangkok to London Gatwick service from four flights a week to daily. They are plans rather than confirmed schedules, because the CAAT still has to allocate slots according to each airport’s capacity. Air Chief Marshal Manat Chavanaprayoon, the CAAT’s director-general, said its representatives attended the 159th IATA Slot Conference in Budapest, Hungary, from November 17 to 19, acting as Thailand’s slot coordinator. U-Tapao, Samui , Chiang Mai, Phuket , Don Mueang and Suvarnabhumi were all on the agenda, with requests for more frequent flights, new international routes and services from carriers that do not yet fly to Thailand. In Bangkok, Air India Express wants to run two flights a week on a route from Visakhapatnam through Suvarnabhumi to Varanasi. summary_cn: 泰国民航局收到87家客运和货运航空公司提交的2027年夏季航班时段调整申请。北欧大西洋航空公司（Norse Atlantic UK）计划将曼谷飞伦敦盖特威克（London Gatwick）航线从每周4班增加至每日班。印度航空快运、哈萨克航空等多家公司也提交了开辟新路线和增班的申请。涉及机场包括素万那普（Suvarnabhumi）、廊曼（Don Mueang）、清迈、普吉等。民航局作为泰国时段协调方，将根据各机场容量和运力条件最终确定时段分配。

title: Chinese boss flees Thailand as police bust alleged Chiang Mai exchange front
desc: Chinese boss flees Thailand as police bust alleged Chiang Mai exchange front Legacy Cyber police have charged a Chinese woman and her Thai nominee over a Chiang Mai exchange shop that allegedly turned online scam money into cryptocurrency for a Chinese boss, who left Thailand before officers raided the shop and his home on November 10. The Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau announced the case yesterday, November 20, saying four victims of fake overseas share investment schemes lost 9,435,607.97 baht in total, sent through 24 mule bank accounts and withdrawn in cash for handover to a Chinese man known as Tiger. Brokers allegedly changed the cash into the USDT stablecoin for a 2% to 3% fee. Police identified Tiger as Wenjun Feng, a 42 year old Chinese national living in Doi Saket district, whose crypto wallet recorded turnover of more than 2,749,566 USDT, about 92 million baht. Nan Provincial Court issued an arrest warrant for Feng on September 25, but he had already left the country, so police asked immigration officers to put him on a watchlist and contacted foreign agencies. Police said Feng and his 36 year old Chinese wife, Yaning Yan, ran the Nimmanhaemin Road shop through Juthama

summary_cn: 泰国网络犯罪调查局于11月20日宣布破获清迈诈骗案。警方突袭了尼曼路（Nimmanhaemin Road）一家兑换店，指控其充当网络投资诈骗资金洗白窗口，将诈骗所得转换为USDT稳定币。华人主谋温俊峰（Wenjun Feng，42岁）在搜查前逃离泰国。其加密钱包处理额超过274万USDT，约9200万泰铢。案件涉及4名受害者，总损失超943万泰铢。

title: Two Indonesians held in alleged Ayutthaya crystal meth pickup
desc: Two Indonesians held in alleged Ayutthaya crystal meth pickup Legacy Police in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya have charged two Indonesian me n after allegedly catching them at the place under a U-turn bridge where two suitcases holding 38 kilogrammes of crystal meth had been left on Wednesday, November 18. Officers are now searching for a man known as Jimmy, who the pair said gave them their orders, and for whoever left the suitcases. The provincial governor and the provincial police chief announced the arrests yesterday, November 20, and put the value of the seized drugs at about 7.6 million baht. A worker cutting grass found the two suitcases under the bridge over the railway at Ban Ma, in Ban Ko subdistrict, and called local police at about 10.30am. Officers opened them and found 38 bags of crystal methamphetamine, each weighing 1 kilogramme and hidden inside pouches that looked like tea packaging. Photo courtesy of KhaoSod Police judged from the state of the suitcases and the area around them that they had been left there only recently and that someone would probably come to collect them, so officers kept watch from several positions. summary_cn: 阿瑜陀耶警方于11月18日在Ban Ma村一座铁路桥下逮捕两名印度尼西亚男子。警方发现装有38公斤冰毒的行李箱后设置伏击，在嫌疑人前来提取时将其逮捕。毒品分成38包，每包1公斤，伪装成茶叶包装以逃避检查。缉获毒品价值约760万泰铢。警方正在追缉指挥者绰号「Jimmy」的人以及遗弃行李箱的嫌疑人。
desc_original: Two Indonesians held in alleged Ayutthaya crystal meth pickup Legacy Police in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya have charged two Indonesian me n after allegedly catching them at the place under a U-turn bridge where two suitcases holding 38 kilogrammes of crystal meth had been left on Wednesday, November 18. Officers are now searching for a man known as Jimmy, who the pair said gave them their orders, and for whoever left the suitcases. The provincial governor and the provincial police chief announced the arrests yesterday, November 20, and put the value of the seized drugs at about 7.6 million baht. A worker cutting grass found the two suitcases under the bridge over the railway at Ban Ma, in Ban Ko subdistrict, and called local police at about 10.30am. Officers opened them and found 38 bags of crystal methamphetamine, each weighing 1 kilogramme and hidden inside pouches that looked like tea packaging. title: Bangkok’s Song Wat Road hosts Loy Krathong drones and river fireworks
desc: Bangkok’s Song Wat Road hosts Loy Krathong drones and river fireworks Legacy Bangkok’s historic Song Wat Road will hold a two-night Song Wat Loy Krathong celebration on November 23 and 24, with a light parade, digital krathong floating and a riverside show of 300 drones and more than 12,000 fireworks. The main show comes on the evening of November 24, the night of the festival itself. The Culture Ministry said on November 20 that Culture Minister Sabida Thaised will open the event, called River Meets Magic in English, at 8.30pm on November 24 at the AWC elephant courtyard in Samphanthawong district. The ministry’s Department of Cultural Promotion is organising it to pass the tradition on to younger Thais and to bring cultural tourism to the old riverside trading district. After a performance of Thai sepha recitation, contemporary dance and lighting, the opening will include a symbolic first krathong released on an immersive LED screen. The drone show over the Chao Phraya River follows, along with a closed-system raft display of more than 560 krathong and the fireworks set off in the middle of the river.
